reanimated.config.title: ReAnimated — Settings
reanimated.studio.title: Animation Studio
reanimated.editor.title: Animation Profile Editor
reanimated.tip.ui_preset: How every screen enters: slide up, grow from the center, or fly in from the front.
reanimated.tip.speed_ticks: Length of the open and close animation, in game ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
reanimated.tip.animate_scope: Whether screens added by other mods are animated too, or only vanilla ones.
reanimated.tip.close_enabled: Play the opening animation in reverse when a screen closes.
reanimated.tip.bg_fade: Fade the dimming behind a screen in and out instead of switching it instantly.
reanimated.tip.lists_enabled: Move lists (mods, servers, worlds) with the screen and bring their rows in one by one.
reanimated.tip.studio: Open the Animation Studio: build your own button animation with a live preview.
reanimated.tip.profile_editor: Open the Profile Editor: precise control over offset, scale, alpha and cascade.
reanimated.tip.own_screen: Open the mod's own settings screen — it also has copy and paste of the whole config.
reanimated.tip.screen_enabled: Animate menu screens: titles and buttons arrive together.
reanimated.tip.screen_distance: How far a menu travels on its way in.
reanimated.tip.screen_easing: Shape of the motion curve for menus.
reanimated.tip.pause_enabled: Give the Esc menu its own animation instead of the general one.
reanimated.tip.pause_preset: Preset for the pause menu; «Same as general» follows the main setting.
reanimated.tip.pause_speed_ticks: Length of the pause menu animation; it is opened often, so a faster value suits it.
reanimated.tip.pause_distance: How far the pause menu travels on its way in.
reanimated.tip.pause_easing: Shape of the motion curve for the pause menu.
reanimated.tip.container_enabled: Animate containers: chests, furnaces, the inventory.
reanimated.tip.container_distance: How far a container panel travels on its way in.
reanimated.tip.container_easing: Shape of the motion curve for containers.
reanimated.tip.hover_scale: How much a hovered button grows. At 0 nothing happens.
reanimated.tip.hover_speed: How quickly a button reaches its hovered size.
reanimated.tip.press_enabled: Dip a button inward when it is pressed.
reanimated.tip.press_scale: How deep a pressed button sinks.
reanimated.tip.press_duration: How long the press animation lasts.
reanimated.tip.slot_enabled: Let the inventory slot highlight follow the cursor smoothly.
reanimated.tip.slot_speed: How quickly the highlight catches up with the cursor.
reanimated.tip.logo_enabled: Animate the Minecraft logo on the main menu.
reanimated.tip.logo_style: Grow the whole logo at once, or assemble it letter by letter.
reanimated.tip.logo_duration: Length of the logo animation in the «grow» style.
reanimated.tip.logo_easing: Shape of the motion curve for the «grow» style.
reanimated.tip.logo_letter_duration: Length of one letter's flight in the letter-by-letter style.
reanimated.tip.logo_letter_offset: How far a letter travels before it settles.
reanimated.tip.logo_letter_easing: Shape of the motion curve for letters.
reanimated.tip.tabs_enabled: Animate the category tabs in Advancements and the Creative inventory.
reanimated.tip.tabs_offset: How far a tab travels from behind the panel.
reanimated.tip.tabs_easing: Shape of the motion curve for tabs.
reanimated.screens.title: ReAnimated — Per-screen settings
reanimated.screens.hint: Screens appear here once you have opened them
reanimated.tip.transition_enabled: Play a transition when one screen replaces another instead of switching instantly.
reanimated.tip.transition_style: Sideways slide, zoom, or both at once.
reanimated.tip.transition_speed: Length of the transition. Short values keep menu navigation snappy.
reanimated.tip.transition_distance: How far a screen travels as it leaves or arrives.
reanimated.tip.transition_easing: Shape of the motion curve for transitions.
reanimated.tip.tooltip_enabled: Grow tooltips out of the cursor instead of showing them instantly.
reanimated.tip.tooltip_duration: How long a tooltip takes to appear.
reanimated.tip.tooltip_scale: Size a tooltip starts at. At 1 it only moves.
reanimated.tip.tooltip_offset: How far a tooltip travels before it settles.
reanimated.tip.tooltip_easing: Shape of the motion curve for tooltips.
reanimated.tip.toast_enabled: Reshape the slide of advancement, recipe and system notifications.
reanimated.tip.toast_duration: How long a toast takes to slide in. Vanilla takes 600 ms, longer is not possible.
reanimated.tip.toast_easing: Shape of the motion curve for toasts.
reanimated.tip.recipebook_enabled: The recipe book grows out from under the container panel instead of appearing at once.
reanimated.tip.recipebook_duration: How long the recipe book takes to appear.
reanimated.tip.recipebook_scale: Size the recipe book starts at, as a share of its final size.
reanimated.tip.recipebook_offset: How far left of its place the recipe book starts.
reanimated.tip.recipebook_easing: Shape of the motion curve for the recipe book.
reanimated.tip.custom_preset: Use an animation added by another mod instead of a built-in preset.
